title: AssetLeaf
description: What an asset type hands out for one of its assets inside a catalog, before the payload has arrived. `'ref'` hands out a deferred AssetRef that resolves once the load settles - the right shape for a decoded value nobody can render early. A SeamlessAdapter hands out the resource itself, empty, and transplants the payload into that same object when it arrives, so consumers wired to it need no re-wiring. `'none'` declares that the type has no meaningful placeholder at all. Its assets cannot appear in a catalog by bare path and must be named explicitly with AssetType.asset.
